interpretation: The requested alignment is the centerline of the actually drawn right stroke of today's white frame directly above the local day-change divider. It is not the right edge of the title-card rectangle and does not move the divider.
cause: The previous anchor aligned the card rectangle's left edge with midnight. The external white outline is generated by currentDayUnifiedShape() with a 4 px inset from the card rectangle. Thus its drawn right stroke centerline was 146.9468285714 logical px to the right of the day-change line: 154.9468285714 card width minus the 8 px total inset. The box itself was not the rendered frame edge.

implementation.dividerRasterization: The divider uses an 8 px rect whose left edge is round(boundaryX - 4); its effective center differs from the frame vector centerline by at most 0.5 logical px.
implementation.preserved: The local-midnight divider and lower timeline clock/geometry are unchanged. All 16 date cards retain their width, gap, clipping, chronology, speed and coverage. Existing frame width, outline path, curve joins, touches, agenda and weather remain unchanged.

naturalClipping: At 00:00 and 23:59 the aligned day-change line is naturally outside the widget's inner horizontal clip [4, 1088] on the 1092 px canvas; the existing outer contour clips the corresponding frame edge. The selected card is not forced onscreen.
